summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements and proposals, including the integration of GitHub Copilot for code reviews and the introduction of fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable responses. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about deprecating equality deletes in Iceberg V4 and migrating to Jackson 3.
highlights: Enable GitHub Copilot for code reviews
Add finer grained read restrictions in loadTable
Deprecate equality deletes in Iceberg V4
